payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate through months, compute required denominator to satisfy p_i / den <= k/100, and greedily add minimal integer increase to previous prices to meet condition, accumulating total increases.
payload.rationale: The solution sequentially enforces the constraint with minimal local increases, which can be proven optimal via exchange argument (shifting increases earlier is never worse). No sorting or complex data structures are used, so greedy_exchange_argument fits best.
